bloc.Carrés = centres de données — l'infrastr: Squares = data centres — the infrastructure under the systems. On hover: announced status, date, capacity and investment, then electricity and water — published where they are, otherwise computed as a range from the capacity (formula shown). Directive (EU) #/#, art. #, now requires centres above # kW to declare energy and water in a European database: these ranges will be replaced by declarations as they appear.
bloc.Ce que fait ce comparateur. Il croise, p: What this comparator does. Country by country, it cross-references carbon intensity and the dispatchability of the mix (nuclear, renewables, fossil plants), water availability (the EEA’s WEI+ index and competition with agricultural irrigation), free-cooling potential, the industrial price of electricity, the fleet in service and the #-# grid connection queue. Set the weight of each criterion to suit your project — new build, extension or acquisition — and read the ranking. Each column carries its nature and its source; the scores mean nothing outside this ranking. Countries are shown in alphabetical order, in a grid of # to # per row, so that you can find yours at a glance without scrolling through twenty-three rows: the rank on each tile is still the one from the ranking by score. To read the podium, choose “Score, descending” under Sort by; to compare criterion by criterion, “Detailed table” under Display.
bloc.Ces critères viennent du référentiel d’i: These criteria come from the CONSEILPREV engineering reference set (the data centre module of conseilprevcyber), which cites ASHRAE TC #, Directive (EU) #/# and its delegated Regulation (EU) #/#, the Climate Neutral Data Centre Pact and ISO/IEC #. They do not change the cost per megawatt — nothing here allows that. They change what happens afterwards: the PUE, hence the electricity, hence the total cost over ten years — that is, the only figure that separates two countries. A value you enter is marked entered: the report will say that it is you who commits to it.
bloc.Ces deux grandeurs sont lues sur la DPGF: These two quantities are read off the bill of quantities for the chosen country — they are not entered here: the table above and the fee scale must state the same base.
bloc.Ces huit tests répondent à ce qu’un inve: These eight tests answer what an investor asks before the envelope: does the demand exist, is the timetable compatible with access to electricity, are the end customers’ needs anticipated. They feed the opinion shown below, together with the findings of the costing — a report has only one verdict. No price is built in: without a declared hosting price, break-even is not computed, it is stated as undetermined.
bloc.Ces trois-là sont déterministes, sans mo: These three are deterministic, with no language model — and that is a choice. A projection must be reproducible by hand by whoever disputes it; an anomaly must say why it is one, “the model detected it” being no reason to put to an operator; and a comment attached to a report must not be able to invent anything. Composed from the quantities already computed, this one asserts only what has been measured and puts the causes as questions.
bloc.Chaque document porte la version de tous: Each document carries the version of every reference set used, the nature of each value, its sources and the caveats that qualify them. No language model takes part in drafting them: they are composed by deterministic calculation, and say so in as many words. They therefore do not carry the article # marking, which would not apply.
bloc.Choisissez les phases que vous confiez e: Choose the phases you entrust and the assignments you retain: the costing follows. The fees apply to the amount of the works — the design-management line and the contingency provision are removed from it — and the scale distinguishes the shell and envelope from the technical package, whose rates differ by a factor of eight on some assignments.
bloc.Contexte, pas preuve. Aucune mesure sate: Context, not proof. No satellite measurement demonstrates the use of an AI. These layers are the raw material of some of the systems listed — never the evidence of their existence.
bloc.Critères de conception — refroidissement: Design criteria — imposed cooling, ASHRAE air class, contractual PUE, load factor, price and carbon intensity of your contract. Each replaces an inference with YOUR data.
bloc.Deux inventaires sur la même carte. Les: Two inventories on the same map. The documented AI cases (POCs, pilots, production, abandonments) mid-# → mid-#, classified under Regulation (EU) #/#, with a cyber vulnerability profile, the regulatory layer of the # Member States and a computed exposure score. And the data centre fleet that runs them: electricity, lifecycle CO₂e, cooling water and siting criteria, country by country. A working base for decision-makers.
bloc.D’où vient le coût au mégawatt, et ce qu: Where the cost per megawatt comes from, and what it does not say. It comes from a published survey — Soben, part of Accenture, Data Centre Trends Report #: “cloud data centres currently cost between $# million and $# million per MW, GW+ AI data centres are costing as much as $# million per MW”. The source is in dollars: the conversion goes through a displayed, editable rate, since a rate of the day is not reference data. It covers cloud and AI campuses, not colocation or the regional site, whose nature is marked accordingly. And it remains a market order of magnitude: this module does not manufacture YOUR price — as none of the # centres in the reference set publishes its capacity, nothing here replaces your quotes. What the module brings is elsewhere: the complete structure of the bill of quantities, the modulation by the sourced criteria alone of this page, the explicit list of what it cannot settle, and the comparison between countries on total cost of ownership — because on capital expenditure alone it would show zero.
bloc.File « à qualifier » : ces titres provie: “To be qualified” queue: these headlines come from the official feeds and are matched to the panel by strict name correspondence. None enters the scores until it has been checked and filed into the reference set (versioned). Automation detects; the expert decides.
bloc.La décision est chiffrée ; elle n’est pa: The decision is costed; it is not examined. What follows goes off to the engineering site: the energy-water-carbon account on one side, the sequence of documents and the price of design management on the other. Two paths, two contents — they are named below.
bloc.La puissance informatique et l’enveloppe: The IT load and the works envelope are taken from the study above. This block derives the quantities, the indicative price and the manufacturing carbon from them — then it returns the amount that will be added to the capital employed in value creation, two blocks further down. Reading it after the EVA would give a ROCE overstated by a third.
bloc.Le bilan énergie, eau et carbone et la t: The energy, water and carbon account and the decarbonisation trajectory are conducted on the firm’s other site. This button builds a link that carries the technical profile there — country and load — so that you do not have to re-enter it. It shows you what it contains before you do anything with it: nothing is sent as long as you do not follow the link.
bloc.Le même calcul répond à deux questions,: The same calculation answers two questions, which is why this block appears in both views. On the investment side: how much equipment the IT load imposes, at what indicative price, and what share of the total. On the footprint side: their manufacturing carbon under GHG Protocol scope #, categories # and # — the third component, without which scopes # and # do not make an account. The module is shared byte for byte with the conseilprevcyber engineering page: the quantities there are the same, line for line.
bloc.Le tableau qui suit est une analyse, pas: The table that follows is an analysis, not data. Advantages, drawbacks and commentary by country — the firm’s reading, dated, open to discussion. Click a country to open the detail of its fleet.
bloc.Le tableau qui suit se lit par pays. Cli: The table that follows reads country by country. Click a country to open the detail of all its data centres: status, commissioning, announced capacity and investment, electricity, water, cooling, CO₂e — and, for each value, whether it is published, inferred from the site or only from its class.
bloc.Les chiffres ci-dessus préparent une déc: The figures above prepare an investment decision. This diagnosis answers the other question, the one rarely asked before commissioning a dashboard: does the organisation have what it takes to examine it, and then to track its execution? A committee that receives a ±# % envelope with no dated series and no reading grid does not decide better with one more chart — it decides on intuition, with a figure for reassurance.
bloc.Les quatorze lots ci-dessus s'arrêtent a: The fourteen packages above stop at the walls, the fluids and the electricity. The IT room fit-out package covers raised floors, cable trays and in-room distribution — it carries the words “excluding servers” itself. The machines are a separate investment, and when the same client carries both, they account for a third of the total investment. Reasoning on the construction envelope alone leads to arbitrating civil engineering savings while the heaviest item goes through without discussion.
bloc.Lire avant d'exploiter : ce panorama est: Read before use: this panorama is a representative panel of publicly documented cases, not a census — deployments that were never disclosed do not appear in it. The score measures the regulatory exposure of the use case (risk class, stage, data, public signals); it is not a compliance audit of the companies named. Only sourced facts (penalties, decisions, public commitments) are attributed by name.
The envelope says what the project costs. These three indicators say what it earns relative to the capital tied up — and they cannot be computed without you: expected revenue, cost of capital and tax rate are investor decisions, not reference data. Until they are entered, all three are not examined, and not zero.
bloc.Prolonger la durée de vie : le gain, et: Extending the lifetime: the gain, and its tipping point. Extending a server’s life spreads its manufacturing carbon over more years and defers the manufacture of a replacement. The gain is real. But a fleet whose average age rises consumes more for the same service delivered. So the question is not whether extension pays: it is how far, and that depends on the electricity mix that feeds the site.
bloc.Publiques, sous licence explicite, inter: Public, under an explicit licence, queryable without registration: you can run the query again. It is the only layer of this page that a reader checks end to end, without us.
bloc.Rappel d'échéances : pratiques interdite: Deadline reminder: prohibited practices in force since # February #; GPAI obligations since # August #; high risk annex III on # December #; annex I on # August #.
bloc.Sélectionnez un pays sur la carte pour a: Select a country on the map to show its authorities (AI Act supervision, cybersecurity, data protection), its AI strategy and the panel cases attached to it.
bloc.Un tableau de bord ne doit pas seulement: A dashboard must not merely display data: it must signal where a decision is expected, without the reader having to compare each value with its target in their head. Three mechanisms do that here — the form chosen for the data, the coloured threshold, and the measured trend. To these are added the three contributions of augmented analytics: projection of the indicator, anomaly detection and natural-language commentary.
bloc.Une alerte ne se déclenche pas sur du br: An alert does not fire on noise. This is what this engine holds and a spreadsheet does not: it knows the uncertainty of its quantities. A ±# % envelope that exceeds its target by # % has crossed nothing — the gap is within the noise. Red requires an overrun greater than both the tolerance and the uncertainty; between the two, the state shown is “gap not demonstrated”. Without this rule, the third false positive puts out vigilance on all the others.
bloc.Une prévision n’est pas une donnée. Les: A forecast is not data. The facts below come from four named publishers’ reports, read in full: each entry carries its verbatim quotation, its page and its publisher, so that you can check it rather than take our word for it. Entries marked forecast commit their author, not reality. And when a later fact makes a value shown elsewhere on this page look optimistic — the Finnish price class is the example — it is recorded as a dated caveat beside it, never silently substituted: you must be able to find again what you quoted last week.
bloc.Vous avez un investissement et un coût d: You have an investment and an operating cost. The next block sets them against the capital employed: a project can be the cheapest and still destroy value, and that is where it shows.
bloc.Vous avez une enveloppe et un pays reten: You have an envelope and a chosen country. The next block derives the amount of the works and the share of the technical package from them — the only two quantities on which the design-management fees depend.
bloc.Vous avez une enveloppe. Personne n’a en: You have an envelope. Nobody has yet asked whether anyone will rent. The business case, under “Set up the project”, tests the demand, the electrical timetable and the occupancy at break-even — and its eight findings feed the same GO / NO GO verdict.
bloc.Vous n’avez pas encore de plan d’affaire: No business plan yet? The calculation still answers the question that decides: how much must this project earn in order not to destroy value? That threshold comes out of the envelope already computed and of two figures only — cost of capital and tax rate, which are decisions, not forecasts. It is shown at the head of the result; the three indicators come next, for whoever has the plan.
bloc.À présenter aux sponsors dès le départ,: To be put to the sponsors from the outset, including when the conclusion disappoints. Recalibrating an ambition at the opening costs one meeting; explaining six months later why the dashboard is not being used costs the project — and the trust that came with it. The summary note below carries the verdict at the head, never in an annex.
